connection_window.description: A time window for the connection establishment in seconds.

connection_retry.description: Number of connection attempts before declaring a permanent failure.

request_timeout.description: Default timeout in seconds for a request response.

stream_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for connection errors with unfulfilled requests.

timeout_resolution.description: Resolution for timeout events in seconds.

stream_error_window.description: Time in seconds after which permanent failure flags are cleared.

worker_threads.description: Number of threads processing user callbacks.

cp_chunk_size.description: Size of a single data chunk handled by xrdcopy in bytes.

cp_parallel_chunks.description: Maximum number of asynchronous requests processed by xrdcopy at any time.

data_server_ttl.description: Time period in seconds after which an idle connection to a data server is closed.

load_balancer_ttl.description: Time period in seconds after which an idle connection to a manager or load balancer is closed.

cp_init_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds allowed for the copy process to initialize.

cptpc_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds allowed for a third-party copy operation to finish.

tcp_keep_alive.description: Enable/Disable TCP keep alive functionality (0 or 1).

tcp_keep_alive_time.description: Time in seconds between last data packet sent and the first keepalive probe (Linux only).

tcp_keep_alive_interval.description: Interval in seconds between subsequent keepalive probes (Linux only).

tcp_keep_probes.description: Number of unacknowledged probes before considering the connection dead (Linux only).

poller_preference.description: A comma separated list of poller implementations in order of preference.

network_stack.description: The network stack to use: IPAuto, IPAll, IPv6, IPv4, IPv4Mapped6.

client_monitor.description: Path to the client monitor library.

client_monitor_param.description: Additional optional parameters for the monitoring object.

plug_in_conf_dir.description: A custom location containing client plug-in config files.

plug_in.description: A default client plug-in to be used.
